verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an official open-source CLI (runpodctl) documented with concrete commands for managing Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, volumes, and file transfer, directly matching an AI-native user's need for CLI-driven automation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (community evidence covers SSH/GPU availability but not runpodctl specifically), and no mention of CLI versioning/release cadence or install stability reports.
